description: This file defines a wrapper service class for TellerRepository, providing methods to find, save, and delete Teller entities with transaction management and exception handling.

classes.name: TellerRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service wrapper class around TellerRepository providing methods for retrieving and persisting Teller objects, with error handling and transaction management.

methods.name: TellerRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that injects the TellerRepository dependency.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a Teller by ID, throws TellerNotFoundException if not found, initializes lazy collections, and returns the Teller.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Persists a Teller entity and flushes changes immediately.
